rigors.requirement: The memo must include all five exact section headings — Executive Summary, Risk Prioritization, Interventions, Measurement Plan, and Equity and Implementation Risks — and each heading must carry a distinct part of the plan rather than repeating another section.
The plan must specify distinct Year 1, Year 2, and Year 3 actions rather than a single undated list of measures.
The memo must not present any single intervention as sufficient on its own, and must name the implementation risks that make a layered response necessary.
